title: Research papers I've read.
subtitle: Research from Uber, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Stanford that shapes how I build observability, Kubernetes platforms and AIOps.

items.title: CRISP: Critical Path Analysis of Large-Scale Microservice Architectures
items.authors: Zhang, Ramanathan, Raj, Parwal, Sherwood, Chabbi
items.relevance: Critical-path analysis over Jaeger traces across Uber's ~40K endpoints — the model for turning traces into latency root causes in incident triage.

items.title: M3: Uber's Open Source, Large-scale Metrics Platform for Prometheus
items.relevance: Remote storage for Prometheus at billions of series — the same problem VictoriaMetrics solves across my 90+ clusters.

items.title: Dapper, a Large-Scale Distributed Systems Tracing Infrastructure
items.relevance: The origin of distributed tracing — sampling and library-level instrumentation that Zipkin, Jaeger and OpenTelemetry descend from.

items.title: Gorilla: A Fast, Scalable, In-Memory Time Series Database
items.relevance: Delta-of-delta timestamps and XOR float compression — the encoding behind the Prometheus TSDB and why metrics storage is cheap.

items.title: Monarch: Google's Planet-Scale In-Memory Time Series Database
items.relevance: Regional ingestion with a global query plane — a reference design for multi-cluster, multi-cloud monitoring.

items.title: Large-scale cluster management at Google with Borg
items.authors: Verma, Pedrosa, Korupolu, Oppenheimer, Tune, Wilkes
items.relevance: Bin-packing, over-commitment and failure-domain spreading — the ideas behind right-sizing, spot and Graviton node pools.

items.title: Borg, Omega, and Kubernetes
items.relevance: Why Kubernetes is built around a watched API store and reconciliation — the pattern every operator and GitOps controller I run relies on.

items.title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Raft)
items.relevance: The consensus protocol inside etcd — essential for reasoning about control-plane quorum, latency and recovery.

items.title: The Tail at Scale
items.relevance: Why p99 dominates user experience at fan-out, and how hedged requests tame it — the lens for every latency SLO.

items.title: Automatic Root Cause Analysis via Large Language Models for Cloud Incidents
items.relevance: LLM-driven incident diagnosis grounded in collected signals and past incidents — the approach behind the triage agents in Cosmic.
